name: world-of-musicians-fullstack
description: World of Musicians Full-Stack Web Platform (React + Vite + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
